scope.summary: Partial, owner-authorized first Xero OAuth connection slice; no Payroll AU submission, Award Central, or issue #61 delivery work.
implemented: Owner/admin-only per-Business Xero OAuth authorization and callback with signed, short-lived, browser-bound CSRF state.
Server-side token exchange, AES-256-GCM encrypted token persistence, Xero organization selection, revocation, and refresh-token rotation under a database lease.
RLS-protected, tenant-scoped database RPCs; cross-business authorization tests; retryable final-organization revocation and fail-closed reauthorization state.
Mocked OAuth tests and owner setup guidance; no live credentials or provider payroll endpoints used.

evidence.outcome: Current AU Payroll v2 contract identifies POST /Timesheets and the payroll.timesheets scope.
Documents the AU Payroll base path, minimal OAuth scopes, separate read scope, required Xero user permissions, and entitlement limitation.

criteria.description: OAuth refresh and permission failure handled

evidence.outcome: 11 mocked tests pass for token exchange, refresh rotation, revoked credentials, provider permission errors, encryption, and refresh-lock behavior.
The isolated pgTAP suite passed; role checks, cross-business denial, refresh leases, reauthorization, and final revocation are covered.
Rotated credentials that cannot be persisted fail closed and mark the grant for reauthorization.

criteria.description: sandbox end-to-end test validates mapping, retries and duplicate prevention.

evidence.outcome: Explicitly records that this OAuth-only slice does not call Payroll AU or validate Demo Company Payroll access.
Tests are synthetic OAuth/provider mocks; payroll mapping, submission retries, and duplicate prevention were not tested.
Owner-authorized first slice excludes live payroll activity; Demo Company Payroll entitlement remains an owner-assisted follow-up.
